fen_walk_spine.accept_text: The spine road, north from this pier through Bloodmoon and over the ridge to the manor gate. The whole length.

fen_wretches.turn_in_text: I knew four of them. I'm sorry for all of them.
fen_wretches.accept_text: The waterlogged wretches, on the beach at the Drowned Docks, and the shingle west of the jetty.

fen_noble_signets.turn_in_text: Houses, four names. The Rear Guard will want these.

fen_altar_aldric.description:
West of the stair is the Bone Circle, and Aldric keeps it.

Centuries. I've checked that against three sources that don't agree about anything else.

Here's what you need to understand before you go west: he's made of the things he keeps. Not armoured in them - MADE of them, and the Circle and the Bonewarden are not two things that happen to be in the same chamber.

Which means the Circle gets smaller when he does. I'd rather you knew that going in than worked it out in the middle.

Unmake him.
